articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5.6 Sol: Here’s How It Stacks Up Against Other AI Models
articles.snippet: OpenAI's new flagship model is out, after spending two weeks locked behind a government-approved preview. It lands the same week Fable 5 leaves Anthropic's subscription plans.

articles.title: Sony Bank Clears OCC Hurdle for Dollar Stablecoin
articles.snippet: The lender's new US subsidiary, Connectia Trust, would issue a dollar-pegged stablecoin once it clears the regulator's final conditions.

articles.title: SEC's Long-Promised Crypto Safe Harbor to Be Introduced as Soon as This Month
articles.snippet: The SEC updated its agenda to indicate that a key crypto rulemaking is slated to be released for public comment in July.
